title: Normalization cokernel sheaf
statement: For a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme], let $S^{\mathrm{rn}}$ be its componentwise reduced normalization [def-weil-pbc-reduced-normalization]. Define the normalization cokernel sheaf $\mathcal Q_S$ to be the cokernel of the canonical morphism of $\mathcal O_S$-modules $\mathcal O_S\to (S^{\mathrm{rn}}\to S)_*\mathcal O_{S^{\mathrm{rn}}}$ induced by the normalization map. This is the sheaf denoted `conductorCokernel S`.
